# Phase Two — Gevurah Critique

The Awtsmoos cuts away the shortcut that merely moves old confusion to another place;
Awtsmoos.com becomes truly clean only when ownership, semantics, mobile geometry, and code all share one face.

## Twenty improvements

1. Do not keep the old `styles()` function as a no-op because nothing outside the file imports it.
2. Do keep the public `renderBookshelf` export unchanged.
3. Avoid `<article>` with nested action semantics that imply the whole card itself is clickable when only buttons act.
4. Use a section/list-like card vessel with explicit controls.
5. Use `replaceChildren()` for root clearing.
6. Do not interpolate bookmark title/folder/path into HTML strings.
7. Preserve item identity exactly when invoking `onOpen(item)`.
8. Preserve removal identity exactly through `onRemove(item.id)`.
9. Group unknown/non-folder item types under the historical `track` bucket.
10. Keep folders before/after tracks according to object insertion from reduction, matching current first-seen grouping semantics unless evidence requires order changes.
11. Use `minmax(min(16rem,100%),1fr)` or equivalent so cards cannot force phone overflow.
12. Use `min-inline-size:0` on body/title/meta/action areas.
13. Let metadata wrap anywhere rather than widening the rail.
14. Use icon/spine only as decoration with `aria-hidden` where applicable.
15. Give buttons explicit labels and `type="button"`.
16. Make Remove destructive but not visually dominant over Open.
17. Ensure action row collapses to one column on very narrow phones.
18. Keep animations to transform/border/background/shadow/opacity.
19. Avoid generic `.modal-btn` styling as the primary Bookshelf ownership layer; add local `.book-action` classes.
20. Regression-test the static import graph as well as source tokens.
